title: Sales quickstart storyboard and annotated screenshots (light deck)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a pared-down sales/solution quickstart deck composed of annotated in-product screenshots that tell a concise onboarding story for prospective customers. The deliverable is a lightweight, editable deck and exportable PNG assets for demand gen and solutions meetings. Emphasize three canonical flows: API quickstart (hosted), Dedicated capacity provisioning, and Console observability for cost/latency. Ensure screenshots are anonymized and production-safe.
scope: Capture and annotate 10 unique in-product screens across desktop and a single mobile hero
Produce a 6-slide lightweight deck (title, 3-flow walkthrough, value props, next steps)
Provide Figma source with editable callouts and component styles
Export PNG/JPEG assets in 2 resolutions (1200x800 and 600x400) and optimized SVG callouts where applicable
Coordinate with PM/Engineering to use a staging environment and mask any PII
deliverables: Annotation guide: text snippets and CTA copy for each slide
Accessibility notes: alt text for every exported image
acceptance_criteria: Deck includes exactly 6 slides and matches the storyboard provided in the PRD
All screenshots are taken from the staging environment or mocked views and have PII masked
Annotations highlight the primary user action and the expected outcome in one short sentence
Assets exported at required resolutions and validated on a 1366x768 and iPhone 14 viewport
Figma file contains named layers and tokens consistent with design system token names
PM sign-off received and one engineering reviewer confirms screenshots reflect real UI state
design_notes: Favor short, imperative callouts (e.g., "Create API key", "Pin model version")
Use brand color tokens: primary-500 for CTAs, neutral-100 for overlays
Add a subtle device frame for mobile hero, keep desktop screenshots edge-to-edge
Avoid complex data tables in screenshots; use example payloads or mocked text where necessary
Include a small inset showing latency/cost breakdown graph for Console observability slide
decisions: Use staging account with seed data and apply automated mask script (approved 2026-02-18)
Limit deck to three canonical flows to keep sales conversations concise (decided 2026-02-20)
Export both PNG and JPEG for compatibility; provide SVG for vector callouts (decided 2026-02-25)
